neighbourhood(cells: List[bool], at: int) -> int is
    let left = cells[(at + cells.count - 1) % cells.count]
    let right = cells[(at + 1) % cells.count]

    return
        (if left then 4 else 0 fi) +
        (if cells[at] then 2 else 0 fi) +
        (if right then 1 else 0 fi)

    let next = LIST(cells.count)

    for at in 0..cells.count do
        next.add((rule >> neighbourhood(cells, at)) & 1 == 1)
    od

    return next
si

    (0..width) |> map(at => at == width / 2) |> collect()

draw(image: IMAGE, rule: int, left: int) is
    image.colour(234ub, 237ub, 244ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(
        cast double(left), cast double(top),
        cast double(left + width), cast double(top + generations))

    image.colour(30ub, 40ub, 70ub)

    let rows = stream(single_cell(), cells => cells || step(rule, cells))
        |> take(generations)

    for row in rows |> index() do
        for at in 0..width do
            if row.value[at] then
                image.set_pixel(left + at, top + row.index)
            fi
        od
    od

    image.colour(60ub, 65ub, 80ub)
    image.text(
        cast double(left + width / 2), cast double(top) - 14.0,
        18.0, "rule {rule}", Anchor.CENTRE)

let image = IMAGE(width * 2 + gap * 3, top + generations + gap * 3)

draw(image, 30, gap)
draw(image, 110, gap * 2 + width)

image.colour(90ub, 95ub, 110ub)
image.text(
    cast double(gap), cast double(top + generations + gap + 12), 13.0,
    "{generations} generations from a single live cell "
    "on a ring of {width}")

image.write("space-time.png")

image.show("space-time.png")
